gap: No result ChatGPT got states that Synology's current Plus models (DS225+/DS425+) ship with DSM kernel builds that do not expose the Celeron J4125's iGPU through the i915 driver, so Plex hardware transcoding fails on stock firmware (Synology support: 'hardware transcoding is not supported on these two models'), nor Plex's own rule that NAS HEVC output needs a Jasper Lake or newer CPU, which separates N100/N150 units from J4125 ones.
standout_why: Compared against starryhope.com (covers DS925+ having no iGPU at all, Docker-only Plex on UGREEN, and TOS 7 vs Plex's TOS 4-6 packages, but never mentions DS225+/DS425+), nasdecoded.com (wrongly states the DS225+'s J4125 'handles Plex hardware transcoding' and recommends it at about $360), terabytewise.com (generic 'confirm firmware still exposes the iGPU', no model-level detail), littlecompute.com (mini PCs only, no NAS OS limits) and ChatGPT's answer (never mentions Synology, driver exposure, Docker device mapping, or the Jasper Lake HEVC-output threshold). The Synology i915 finding and the Plex HEVC-output threshold are new; the Docker /dev/dri mapping and TOS 7 packaging gap are partly on starryhope. It removes a rival's recommended candidate rather than changing the top pick.
decides: Confirms the UGREEN DXP2800 (N100) and TerraMaster F2-425 Plus (N150) as the viable picks and rules out every Synology under $500: DS225+/DS425+ cannot hardware-transcode on stock DSM (workaround must be re-run after every reboot), and the J4125 in all three Synology candidates cannot produce HEVC output per Plex. It also demotes the N5095 budget pick: Plex says NAS HEVC output needs 'JasperLake or better', so the N5095 is at the floor while N100/N150 are above it. Buyer must also budget a Plex Pass and, on UGREEN, map /dev/dri/renderD128 into the Plex container, since UGOS Pro has no native Plex package. For TerraMaster, Plex publishes NAS packages only for TOS 4 and TOS 5 & 6 while the N150 F2-425 Plus ships TOS 7 ($499.99, out of stock today), so Plex may have to run in Docker there too.

findings.label: Plex hardware transcoding requires Plex Pass
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Hardware-accelerated streaming is a premium feature and requires an active Plex Pass subscription.' Minimum CPU listed as 2nd-gen Intel Core; Broadwell or newer recommended.

findings.label: Plex NAS HEVC output CPU floor
findings.note: Verbatim: 'NAS users will require JasperLake or better CPU to reliably transcode to HEVC output.' HEVC encoding needs PMS 1.41.3+. Puts J4125 (Gemini Lake: DS224+/DS225+/DS425+) below the line, N5095/N5105 (Jasper Lake: F2-425, TS-264, AS5402T) at it, N100/N150 above it. Also: 'Compatible TerraMaster NAS devices require Plex Media Server 1.13.9 or newer.'

findings.label: Plex HDR-to-SDR hardware tone mapping on Linux/Docker/NAS
findings.value: Intel Kaby Lake or newer; PMS 1.29.2 or newer
findings.source_title: HDR to SDR Tone Mapping | Plex Support
findings.note: Verbatim for Linux, Docker and NAS: 'Requires an Intel "Kaby Lake" or newer processor' and 'Requires Plex Media Server v1.29.2 or newer.' Feature covers HDR10. Page does not name specific NAS vendors or Alder Lake-N explicitly.

findings.label: Synology support statement on hardware transcoding
findings.source_title: Synology DS425+ hardware transcoding issue - Plex Forum (page 4)
findings.note: Synology support reply quoted by forum user Plichtao on 2025-09-10: 'I must clarify that hardware transcoding is not supported on these two models' and 'I would like to sincerely apologize for the confusion caused by my earlier reply.' findings.label: Plex engineer on the mechanism
findings.value: DSM 5.10 kernel lacks i915 iGPU access; Plex cannot fix it
findings.source_title: Synology DS425+ hardware transcoding issue - Plex Forum (page 4)
findings.note: ChuckPa (identifies himself in the thread as Plex's Synology development engineer), 2025-09-14: 'VERY sorry folks but without the kernel drivers included to access the ASIC via the i915, there is nothing we can do.' and 'Until such time as I receive word that Synology will add support for the DS425+ in their new 5.10 linux kernel'. On page 6, 2025-10-03: 'It means the kernel build is not correct for HW transcoding access in all modes.'

findings.label: Community workaround for x25 models
findings.value: Reload replacement i915.ko modules after every reboot
findings.source_title: Unlocking PLEX HW transcoding on x25 Synology models - Blackvoid
findings.note: Published 2025-09-23, updated through 2026-07-15. Stock i915.ko is present but 'does not trigger HW transcoding as it should'; fix uses rmmod/insmod of replacement modules compiled for DSM 7.2/7.3 (kernel 5.10) with a v4 build for DSM 7.4. Steps 'will need to be run after each reboot' (author suggests Task Scheduler). Author quotes Synology support: 'hardware transcoding is not supported on these two models.' Plex forum user Plichtao (2025-10-10) adds the workaround's 'only limitation concerns tone mapping on 2160p videos'.

findings.note: Spec sheet lists 'CPU Model: Intel Celeron J4125' and '3-year hardware warranty, extendable to 5 years' but contains no hardware/video transcoding line at all; the only H.264/H.265 figures are Surveillance Station camera limits.
